# TikTok

> > TikTok is a leading short-form video platform offering creative tools, business advertising solutions, and comprehensive safety initiatives for a global community.

TikTok provides resources for creators, businesses, and users worldwide, including TikTok for Business (advertising platform with Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, and TikTok Shop), safety partnerships with NGOs and experts, and various marketing solutions like Branded Hashtag Challenges and TopView ads. The platform serves diverse markets across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and Latin America.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- Ads Manager
- Creator Marketplace
- Branded Hashtag Challenge
- TopView
- Brand Takeover
- TikTok Shop
- Creative Center
- User-generated content (UGC)
- Influencer marketing
- Platform safety
- Content moderation
- NGO collaboration
- Brand awareness campaigns
- Full-funnel marketing

## Safety & Trust

- [Safety partners](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-sg/safety-partners): TikTok's partnerships with NGOs and experts for platform safety

## Business Case Studies - Asia Pacific

- [Pocky | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/pocky-326): Pocky's hashtag challenge driving brand awareness in Indonesia
- [PUBG Mobile Vietnam | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/pubg-mobile-vietnam-235): PUBG Mobile's branded hashtag challenge with Jack in Vietnam
- [TOA Paint Group | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/toa-paint-group-316): TOA Paint's campaign targeting young Thai consumers with UGC
- [CoLearn | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/colearn-216): Indonesian education app's AEO campaign for student acquisition
- [Arnott's Shapes | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/arnott%27s-shapes-251): Arnott's Shapes reviving iconic tagline for Australian youth market

## Business Case Studies - Europe

- [gitti conscious beauty | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/gitti-conscious-beauty-241): German beauty brand's Valentine's Day TopView campaign results
- [Newcastle University | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/newcastle-university-200): Newcastle University's student recruitment campaign in the UK
- [L'Oreal Elvive | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/l%E2%80%99oreal-elvive-247): L'Oreal Elvive DreamLong awareness campaign in Italy
